authoring_method: Rows, columns, spans, header roles, cell texts and questions are AI generated from the page images of NASDAQ_AROW_2019. scripts/build_examples.py requires every cell text to equal the PDF text layer, ignoring whitespace, and derives all geometry from the matched words.

row_kinds.column_header: Column headers. An empty first cell is a blank header.
row_kinds.section: One cell spanning every column; it heads the rows beneath it.
row_kinds.body: Default. The first cell is the row header and the others are data.
